name: react-loop
description: Portable ReAct loop for reasoning over context, taking actions, reflecting on results, and iterating until completion or handoff.

phases.objective: Assess the current context, form the next action plan, and decide whether to proceed into execution, continue reasoning, or hand off.

outcomes.description: The next step is clear enough to move into execution.
The loop should continue reasoning because the next action plan is not yet strong enough.
The work should hand off because the current runtime lacks authority, context, or the right surface to continue.

phases.objective: Execute the current plan, gather the new observations, and update working state so the next reflection pass has concrete results to inspect.
Evaluate the latest action result, decide whether the work is complete, needs another reasoning pass, or should hand off.

outcomes.description: The loop has enough result quality and evidence to finish cleanly.
The loop should return to reasoning because another plan/action pass is needed.
The work should hand off because reflection surfaced a boundary another owner should resolve.
